$description: Theme-independent tokens from docs/design-system.md sections 6 and 7. A px value here means sp for typography (fontSize, lineHeight) and dp for everything else.

space.$description: 4dp grid. px here means dp on Android.

mono.$description: Permissions, hashes and editor paths only.

meta.$description: Size, date, counts (tabular numbers), button hints

typography.$description: Font sizes in px here mean sp on Android, so they follow the system font size.

appBar.$description: Top app bar height in touch mode (prototype .appbar).

topBar.$description: Height of the Dual layout's top bar above both panes (prototype .topbar).

border.$description: Outline width of buttons and fields (prototype .btn border).

focusRing.$description: Gamepad focus ring stroke width (prototype .gf outline).

focusRingGap.$description: Gap between a filled or selected control and its focus ring (prototype outline-offset 2px); rows draw the ring inside instead.

hintFooter.$description: Height of the gamepad button-hint footer (prototype .hints).

hintGlyph.$description: Size of a button glyph in the hint footer (prototype .gl).

hintGlyphBorder.$description: Outline width of a hint glyph (prototype .gl border).

dualMinWidth.$description: Window width from which Auto layout shows two panes (design-system §2). Narrower windows use phone spacing, such as the hint footer's m gap (prototype .dev[data-d=phone] .hints).

activePaneBar.$description: Height of the accent bar on top of the active pane's header in Dual (prototype .pane.active .phead::before).

selectionCheck.$description: Diameter of a row's selection check while selecting (prototype .chk).

selectionCheckBorder.$description: Outline width of an unselected row's check (prototype .chk border).

checkGlyph.$description: The check mark inside a selected row's check (prototype .chk svg).

selectionBar.$description: Height of the active pane's selection header in Dual (prototype .psel).

selectionButton.$description: Height of a button in the Dual selection header (prototype .psel .btn).

buttonIcon.$description: Icon size inside a text button (prototype .btn svg).

actionMinWidth.$description: Minimum width of one action in the phone's selection action bar (prototype .act).

selectionLabelsMinWidth.$description: Narrowest Dual pane whose selection header labels Copy and Move; narrower panes (a 640dp handheld) show icons only, so the count keeps its room.

settingRow.$description: Minimum height of a Settings row (prototype .set-row).

settingChip.$description: Height of a choice chip in a Settings section (prototype .segs .chip).

swatch.$description: Touch target of an accent swatch in Settings (prototype .sw).

swatchDot.$description: The colored dot inside an accent swatch: the swatch inset by 6 (prototype .sw::before).

swatchRing.$description: The ring around the selected accent swatch, inset 2 (prototype .sw[aria-checked] ::after).
